name: Thai Red Chicken Meatballs with Rice

components.name: Chicken Meatballs
steps: Squeeze moisture from grated zucchini, then mix with chicken mince, chilli, ginger, garlic, coriander, spring onion, egg, soy sauce and measured seasonings.
Roll into even meatballs and brown in a skillet with 15 ml oil in batches; they will finish cooking in the sauce.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Cook washed jasmine rice in 550 ml water, covered on low heat, then rest and fluff.

components.name: Red Curry Sauce & Vegetables
steps: Bloom Thai red curry paste in the same pan; add spring onions, ginger and garlic and stir until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk, stock, fish sauce, soy sauce and sliced red pepper; simmer five minutes.
Return meatballs to sauce for around six minutes; add broccolini for final four minutes, cooking until chicken meatballs reach 74°C.
Finish with lime and coriander. Divide rice, curry and meatballs evenly into five containers; freeze later-week portions.
